title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Data Factory & Linked Service Service Pattern
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvcpat-azuredatafactory'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.
module_name: Azure Data Factory & Linked Service Service Pattern

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

datafactory_dataset.type: object({ azure_blob_dataset_config = optional(map(object({ linked_service_name = optional(string, null) name = string folder = optional(string, null) })), {}) custom_dataset_config = optional(map(any), {}) })
datafactory_dataset.description: (Optional) Configuration for Azure Data Factory datasets. - `azure_blob_dataset_config` - (Optional) Map of Azure Blob dataset definitions. - `linked_service_name` - (Optional) Linked Service name/key to associate with the dataset. - `name` - (Required) Name of the dataset. - `folder` - (Optional) Folder path in Data Factory where the dataset is created. - `custom_dataset_config` - (Optional) Map of custom dataset definitions passed to the dataset module. - If `linked_service.name` is provided and `linked_service` input is enabled, the value can be a custom linked service key and will be resolved using linked service module outputs.

datafactory_pipeline.type: object({ description = optional(string, null) annotations = optional(list(string), []) concurrency = optional(number, 1) folder = optional(string, null) moniter_metrics_after_duration = optional(string, null) parameters = optional(map(any), {}) variables = optional(map(any), {}) activities_json = string })
datafactory_pipeline.description: (Optional) Configuration for Azure Data Factory pipeline module. - `description` - (Optional) Description for the pipeline. - `annotations` - (Optional) List of annotations for the pipeline. - `concurrency` - (Optional) Max concurrent runs. - `folder` - (Optional) Pipeline folder path. - `moniter_metrics_after_duration` - (Optional) Monitor metrics duration. - `parameters` - (Optional) Pipeline parameters map. - `variables` - (Optional) Pipeline variables map. - `activities_json` - (Required) JSON string for pipeline activities.

enable_github_configuration.description: (Optional) Boolean to enable github configuration for data factory.

enable_global_parameter.description: (Optional) Boolean to enable global parameter for data factory.

enable_vsts_configuration.description: (Optional) Boolean to enable vsts configuration for data factory.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

firewall_private_ip_address.description: (Optional). Azure firewall private Ip Address. Used when creating routes to firewall during route table creation.

github_configuration.type: object({ account_name = string branch_name = string git_url = string repository_name = string root_folder = string publishing_enabled = optional(bool, false) })
github_configuration.description: - `github_configuration` - (Optional) An Object of GitHub Configuration: - `account_name` - (Required) Specifies the GitHub account name. - `branch_name` - (Required) Specifies the branch of the repository to get code from. - `git_url` - (Required) Specifies the GitHub Enterprise host name. For example: https://github.mydomain.com. Use https://github.com for open source repositories. - `repository_name` - (Required) Specifies the name of the git repository. - `root_folder` - (Required) Specifies the root folder within the repository. Set to / for the top level. - `publishing_enabled` - (Optional) Is automated publishing enabled?

global_parameter.type: list(object({ name = string type = string value = string }))
global_parameter.description: - `global_parameter` - (Optional) A List of Global Parameters: - `name` - (Required) Specifies the global parameter name. - `type` - (Required) Specifies the global parameter type. Possible Values are `Array`, `Bool`, `Float`, `Int`, `Object` or `String`. - `value` - (Required) Specifies the global parameter value.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_config.type: object({ context = optional(string, null) instance = optional(string, null) deploy_kv_and_pe = optional(bool, true) key_vault_id = optional(string, null) sku_name = optional(string, "premium") enabled_for_deployment = optional(bool, false) enabled_for_disk_encryption = optional(bool, true) enabled_for_template_deployment = optional(bool, false) soft_delete_retention_days = optional(number, 30) public_network_access_enabled = optional(bool, false) kv_admin_role_app_spn_object_id = optional(string, null) adf_cmk_expiration_date = string network_acls = optional(object({ bypass = optional(string, "None") default_action = optional(string, "Deny") ip_rules = optional(list(string), []) virtual_network_subnet_ids = optional(list(string), []) }), {}) private_endpoint = optional(object({ is_manual_connection = optional(bool, false) static_ip_required = optional(bool, false) private_connection_resource_alias = optional(string, null) request_message = optional(string, null) ip_configuration = optional(map(object({ private_ip_address = string subresource_name = optional(string, "sites") member_name = optional(string, "sites") })), {}) }), { is_manual_connection = false static_ip_required = false private_connection_resource_alias = null } ) })
key_vault_config.description: - `key_vault_config` - (Required) Object with configuration for the Keyvault. As defined below - `context` - (Optional) Context to be used for KeyVaults being deployed. - `instance` - (Optional) Instance to be used for KeyVaults being deployed. - `deploy_kv_and_pe` - (Optional) Boolean to deploy KeyVault and Private Endpoint for KeyVault. Default is true. - `key_vault_id` - (Optional) KeyVault ID to be used for Private Endpoint for KeyVault. Required if deploy_kv_and_pe is false. - `sku_name` - (Optional) Sku name for KeyVault. Default is premium. - `enabled_for_deployment` - (Optional) Boolean to enable KeyVault for deployment. Default is false. - `enabled_for_disk_encryption` - (Optional) Boolean to enable KeyVault for disk encryption. Default is true. - `enabled_for_template_deployment` - (Optional) Boolean to enable KeyVault for template deployment. Default is false. - `soft_delete_retention_days` - (Optional) The number of days that items should be retained for once soft-deleted. - `public_network_access_enabled` - (Optional) Specifies whether public network access is enabled for the Key Vault. Default is false. - `kv_admin_role_app_spn_object_id` - (optional). Object ID for the SPN to add KeyVault administrator role. - `network_acls` - (Optional) Object with network ACLs for KeyVault. As defined below - `bypass` - (Optional) Specifies whether traffic is bypassed for Azure services. Default is None. Possible values are None, AzureServices, Logging, Metrics, or AzureServices,Logging,Metrics. - `default_action` - (Optional) Specifies the default action of allow or deny when no other rules match. Default is Deny. Possible values are Allow and Deny. - `ip_rules` - (Optional) List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges to whitelist. Only IPV4 addresses are allowed. This list must not include IP address ranges within Azure services. This list can include IP addresses ranges from on-premises ranges. - `virtual_network_subnet_ids` - (Optional) List of virtual network subnet ids to whitelist. This list must not include IP address ranges within Azure services. - `private_endpoint` - (Optional) Object with private endpoint configuration for KeyVault. As defined below - `is_manual_connection` - (Optional) Boolean to indicate if the connection is manual. Default is false. - `static_ip_required` - (Optional) Boolean to indicate if static IP is required. Default is false. - `private_connection_resource_alias` - (Optional) Resource alias of the private connection. Required if is_manual_connection is true. - `request_message` - (Optional) A message passed to the owner of the remote resource when the private endpoint attempts to establish the connection to the remote resource. The provider allows a maximum request message length of `140` characters, however the request message maximum length is dependent on the service the private endpoint is connected to. Only valid if `is_manual_connection` is set to true. - `ip_configuration` - (Optional). Object with IP configuration for KeyVault. As defined below - `private_ip_address` - (Required) Private IP address of the IP configuration. - `subresource_name` - (Optional) Subresource name of the IP configuration. Default is vault. - `member_name` - (Optional) Member name of the IP configuration. Default is default.

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

Required fields name = string authentication_type = string # "SQL", "ServicePrincipal", "SystemAssignedManagedIdentity", "UserAssignedManagedIdentity" # Connection properties - either connection string OR server+database connection_string_key_vault = optional(object({ linked_service_name = string secret_name = string secret_version = optional(string) })) connection_string_secure = optional(string) server = optional(string) database = optional(string) # SQL Authentication username = optional(string) key_vault_password = optional(object({ linked_service_name = string secret_name = string secret_version = optional(string) })) password_secure = optional(string) # Legacy service principal key field (for backward compatibility) key_vault_service_principal_key = optional(object({ linked_service_name = string secret_name = string secret_version = optional(string) })) service_principal_key_secure = optional(string) # User Assigned Managed Identity credential_reference_name = optional(string) # Connection tuning properties encrypt = optional(bool) trust_server_certificate = optional(bool) host_name_in_certificate = optional(string) application_intent = optional(string) connect_timeout = optional(number) connect_retry_count = optional(number) connect_retry_interval = optional(number) command_timeout = optional(number) load_balance_timeout = optional(number) failover_partner = optional(string) max_pool_size = optional(number) min_pool_size = optional(number) multiple_active_result_sets = optional(bool) multi_subnet_failover = optional(bool) packet_size = optional(number) pooling = optional(bool) integrated_security = optional(bool) azure_cloud_type = optional(string) # Integration Runtime and metadata integration_runtime_name = optional(string) encrypted_credential = optional(string) description = optional(string) annotations = optional(list(string)) parameters = optional(map(any)) # Always Encrypted settings always_encrypted_settings = optional(object({ akv_auth_type = string # "ServicePrincipal", "ManagedIdentity", "UserAssignedManagedIdentity" credential_reference_name = optional(string) service_principal_id = optional(string) service_principal_key = optional(string) })) })), {}) azure_sftp_linked_service_config = optional(map(object({ name = string host = string port = optional(number, 22) authentication_type = optional(string, "Basic") username = string password = optional(object({ type = string // 'AzureKeyVaultSecret' secretName = optional(string) secretVersion = optional(string) store = optional(object({ referenceName = string // Key Vault Linked Service name type = string // 'LinkedServiceReference' })) }), null) private_key_content = optional(object({ type = string // 'AzureKeyVaultSecret' secretName = optional(string) secretVersion = optional(string) store = optional(object({ referenceName = string // Key Vault Linked Service name type = string // 'LinkedServiceReference' })) }), null) private_key_passphrase = optional(object({ type = string // 'AzureKeyVaultSecret' secretName = optional(string) secretVersion = optional(string) store = optional(object({ referenceName = string // Key Vault Linked Service name type = string // 'LinkedServiceReference' })) }), null) host_key_fingerprint = optional(string) skip_host_key_validation = optional(bool, false) description = optional(string) integration_runtime_name = optional(string) annotations = optional(list(string), []) parameters = optional(map(any), {}) encrypted_credential = optional(string) tags = optional(map(string), {}) })), {}) azure_file_storage_linked_service_config = optional(map(object({ name = string deploy_fileshare = optional(bool, false) # Flag to deploy file share service_endpoint = optional(string, null) connection_string = optional(string, null) connection_string_secure = optional(string, null) file_share = optional(string, null) snapshot = optional(string, null) host = optional(string, null) user_id = optional(string, null) password_secure = optional(string, null) sas_uri = optional(string, null) sas_uri_secure = optional(string, null) encrypted_credential = optional(string, null) description = optional(string, null) integration_runtime_name = optional(string, null) annotations = optional(list(string), []) parameters = optional(map(any), {}) # Key Vault integration for connection string connection_string_key_vault = optional(object({ linked_service_name = string secret_name = string secret_version = optional(string) }), null) # Key Vault integration for account key key_vault_account_key = optional(object({ linked_service_name = string secret_name = string secret_version = optional(string) }), null) # Key Vault integration for SAS URI sas_uri_key_vault = optional(object({ linked_service_name = string secret_name = string secret_version = optional(string) }), null) # Key Vault integration for SAS token key_vault_sas_token = optional(object({ linked_service_name = string secret_name = string secret_version = optional(string) }), null) # Key Vault integration for password (legacy authentication) key_vault_password = optional(object({ linked_service_name = string secret_name = string secret_version = optional(string) }), null) # User-assigned managed identity credential reference credential_reference_name = optional(string, null) # File share configuration (only used when deploy_fileshare = true) fileshare_config = optional(object({ storage_account_name = optional(string, null) # Optional: specify existing storage account name, defaults to pattern's storage account context = optional(string, null) instance = optional(string, null) quota = optional(number, 5120) access_tier = optional(string, "TransactionOptimized") enabled_protocol = optional(string, "SMB") }), null) })), {}) datafactory_credential_config = optional(map(object({ name = string })), null) })
linked_service.description: - `linked_service` - (Optional) An object for Azure Data Factory Linked Services. Defaults to `{}`. - `azure_kv_linked_service_config` - (Optional) Configuration for Azure Keyvault Linked Services is below. - `name` - (Required)The Name of the Azure Key Vault Linked Service. - `key_vault_id` - (Required)The ID the Azure Key Vault resource. - `description` - (Optional)The description for the Data Factory Linked Service Key Vault. - `annotations` - (Optional) List of tags that can be used for describing the Data Factory Linked Service Key Vault - `parameters` - (Optional) A map of parameters to associate with the Data Factory Linked Service Key Vault. - `additional_properties` - (Optional) A map of additional properties to associate with the Data Factory Linked Service Key Vault. - `azure_sql_linked_service_config` - (Optional) Configuration for Azure SQL Linked Services is below. - `name` - (Required) Specifies the name of the Data Factory Linked Service Azure SQL Database. - `connection_string` - (Optional) The connection string in which to authenticate with Azure SQL Database. - `service_principal_id` - (Optional) The service principal id in which to authenticate against the Azure SQL Database. - `service_principal_key` - (Optional) The service principal key in which to authenticate against the Azure SQL Database. - `tenant_id` - (Optional) The tenant id or name in which to authenticate against the Azure SQL Database. - `description` - (Optional) The description for the Data Factory Linked Service Azure SQL Database. - `annotations` - (Optional) List of tags that can be used for describing the Data Factory Linked Service Azure SQL Database. - `parameters` - (Optional) A map of parameters to associate with the Data Factory Linked Service Azure SQL Database. - `additional_properties` - (Optional) A map of additional properties to associate with the Data Factory Linked Service Azure SQL Database. - `key_vault_connection_string` - (Optional) A key_vault_connection_string block as defined below. - `linked_service_name` - (Required) Specifies the name of an existing Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service. - `secret_name` - (Required) Specifies the secret name in Azure Key Vault that stores SQL Server connection string. - `key_vault_password` - (Optional) A key_vault_connection_string block as defined below. - `linked_service_name` - (Required) Specifies the name of an existing Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service. - `secret_name` - (Required) Specifies the secret name in Azure Key Vault that stores SQL Server connection string. - `azure_sqltable_dataset_service_config` - (Optional) Configuration for Azure SQL Table Dataset Services is below. - `name` - (Required) Specifies the name of the Data Factory Dataset Azure SQL Table. - `schema` - (Optional) The schema name of the table in the Azure SQL Database. - `table` - (Optional) The table name of the table in the Azure SQL Database. - `folder` - (Optional) The folder that this Dataset is in. If not specified, the Dataset will appear at the root level. - `description` - (Optional) The description for the Data Factory Dataset Azure SQL Table. - `annotations` - (Optional) List of tags that can be used for describing the Data Factory Dataset Azure SQL Table. - `parameters` - (Optional) A map of parameters to associate with the Data Factory Dataset Azure SQL Table. - `additional_properties` - (Optional) A map of additional properties to associate with the Data Factory Dataset Azure SQL Table. - `schema_column` - (Optional) A schema_column block as defined below. - `name` - (Required) The name of the column. - `type` - (Optional) Type of the column. Valid values are Byte, Byte[], Boolean, Date, DateTime,DateTimeOffset, Decimal, Double, Guid, Int16, Int32, Int64, Single, String, TimeSpan . Please note these values are case sensitive. - `description` - (Optional) The description of the column. - `azure_function_config` - (Optional) Configuration for Azure Function Linked Service is below. - `name` - (Required) Specifies the name of the Data Factory Linked Service. Changing this forces a new resource to be created - `description` - (Optional) The description for the Data Factory Linked Service. - `url` - (Required) The url of the Azure Function. - `key` - (Optional) The system key of the Azure Function. - `annotations` - (Optional) List of tags that can be used for describing the Data Factory Linked Service. - `parameters` - (Optional) A map of parameters to associate with the Data Factory Linked Service." - `additional_properties` - (Optional) A map of additional properties to associate with the Data Factory Linked Service. - `key_vault_key` - (Optional) A key_vault_key block as defined below. - `linked_service_name` - (Required) Specifies the name of an existing Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service. - `secret_name` - (Required) Specifies the secret name in Azure Key Vault that stores the system key of the Azure Function. - `azure_sqlmi_linked_service_config` - (Optional) Configuration for Azure SQL Managed Instance Linked Services is below. - `name` - (Required) The Name of the Azure SQL Managed Instance Linked Service. - `data_factory_id` - (Required) The Data Factory ID in which to associate the Linked Service with. - `connection_string` - (Optional) The connection string to authenticate with the Azure SQL Managed Instance. - `server` - (Optional) The SQL Managed Instance server name. - `database` - (Optional) The database name. - `username` - (Optional) The username for SQL authentication. - `authentication_type` - (Optional) The authentication type. Possible values: 'SystemAssignedManagedIdentity', 'UserAssignedManagedIdentity', 'ServicePrincipal', 'SQL'. Defaults to 'SystemAssignedManagedIdentity'. - `service_principal_id` - (Optional) The service principal id for ServicePrincipal authentication. - `service_principal_key` - (Optional) The service principal key for ServicePrincipal authentication. - `service_principal_credential_type` - (Optional) The service principal credential type. - `tenant_id` - (Optional) The tenant id for ServicePrincipal authentication. - `credential_reference_name` - (Optional) The credential reference name for UserAssignedManagedIdentity authentication. - `azure_cloud_type` - (Optional) The Azure cloud type. Possible values: 'AzurePublic', 'AzureChina', 'AzureUsGovernment', 'AzureGermany'. - `application_intent` - (Optional) The application intent. Possible values: 'ReadWrite', 'ReadOnly'. - `command_timeout` - (Optional) The command timeout in seconds. - `connect_retry_count` - (Optional) The connection retry count. - `connect_retry_interval` - (Optional) The connection retry interval in seconds. - `connect_timeout` - (Optional) The connection timeout in seconds. - `encrypt` - (Optional) Whether to encrypt the connection. - `integrated_security` - (Optional) Whether to use integrated security. - `trust_server_certificate` - (Optional) Whether to trust the server certificate. - `hostname_in_certificate` - (Optional) The hostname in the certificate. - `pooling` - (Optional) Whether to enable connection pooling. - `max_pool_size` - (Optional) The maximum pool size. - `min_pool_size` - (Optional) The minimum pool size. - `load_balance_timeout` - (Optional) The load balance timeout in seconds. - `multiple_active_result_sets` - (Optional) Whether to enable multiple active result sets. - `multi_subnet_failover` - (Optional) Whether to enable multi-subnet failover. - `failover_partner` - (Optional) The failover partner server name. - `packet_size` - (Optional) The network packet size. - `encrypted_credential` - (Optional) The encrypted credential for authentication. - `description` - (Optional) The description for the Data Factory Linked Service. - `integration_runtime_name` - (Optional) The integration runtime reference to associate with the Data Factory Linked Service. - `annotations` - (Optional) List of tags that can be used for describing the Data Factory Linked Service. - `parameters` - (Optional) A map of parameters to associate with the Data Factory Linked Service. - `key_vault_password` - (Optional) Key Vault reference for password authentication. - `linked_service_name` - (Required) Specifies the name of an existing Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service. - `secret_name` - (Required) Specifies the secret name in Azure Key Vault that stores the password. - `secret_version` - (Optional) Specifies the version of the secret. - `key_vault_service_principal_key` - (Optional) Key Vault reference for service principal key. - `linked_service_name` - (Required) Specifies the name of an existing Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service. - `secret_name` - (Required) Specifies the secret name in Azure Key Vault that stores the service principal key. - `secret_version` - (Optional) Specifies the version of the secret. - `key_vault_service_principal_credential` - (Optional) Key Vault reference for service principal credential. - `linked_service_name` - (Required) Specifies the name of an existing Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service. - `secret_name` - (Required) Specifies the secret name in Azure Key Vault that stores the service principal credential. - `secret_version` - (Optional) Specifies the version of the secret. - `always_encrypted_settings` - (Optional) Always Encrypted settings for enhanced security. - `akv_auth_type` - (Optional) The Azure Key Vault authentication type for Always Encrypted. - `credential_reference_name` - (Optional) The credential reference name for Always Encrypted. - `service_principal_id` - (Optional) The service principal id for Always Encrypted. - `azure_sftp_linked_service_config` - (Optional) Configuration for Azure Data Factory SFTP Linked Service is below. - `name` = (Required) Name of the Data Factory Linked Service. - `data_factory_id` = (Required) The Data Factory resource ID. - `host` = (Required) SFTP server hostname. - `port` = (Optional) SFTP server port. Default: 22. - `authentication_type` = (Optional) Authentication type. Valid: 'Basic', 'MultiFactor', 'SshPublicKey'. Default: 'Basic'. - `username` = (Required) Username for SFTP login. - `password` = (Optional) SecretBase object for password. Use SecureString or AzureKeyVaultSecret. - `private_key_content` = (Optional) SecretBase object for SSH private key (Base64, OpenSSH format). - `private_key_passphrase` = (Optional) SecretBase object for passphrase to decrypt the SSH private key. - `host_key_fingerprint` = (Optional) Host key fingerprint for SFTP server. - `skip_host_key_validation` = (Optional) Whether to skip host key validation. Default: false. - `description` = (Optional) Description for the linked service. - `integration_runtime_name` = (Optional) Integration runtime reference. - `annotations` = (Optional) List of tags for the linked service. - `parameters` = (Optional) Map of parameters for the linked service. - `encrypted_credential` = (Optional) Encrypted credential string. - `tags` = (Optional) Map of tags for the resource. - For Key Vault integration, set type = 'AzureKeyVaultSecret', provide secretName, and set store.referenceName to the Key Vault linked service name. - `azure_file_storage_linked_service_config` - (Optional) Configuration for Azure File Storage Linked Services using AzAPI provider is below. - `name` - (Required) Specifies the name of the Data Factory Linked Service. Must be unique within a data factory. - `deploy_fileshare` - (Optional) Boolean flag to indicate whether to deploy the file share along with the filestorage linked service. Default is false. - `service_endpoint` - (Optional) File service endpoint (e.g., https:// .file.core.windows.net/). Required for managed identity auth. - `connection_string` - (Optional) Plain connection string without account key. Use with key_vault_account_key. - `connection_string_secure` - (Optional) Connection string as SecureString (inline). Mutually exclusive with connection_string_key_vault. - `file_share` - (Optional) The azure file share name. - `snapshot` - (Optional) The date of the file share snapshot (for snapshot reads). - `host` - (Optional) Host name of the server (legacy auth, e.g., \\\\ .file.core.windows.net\\ ). - `user_id` - (Optional) User ID to log in (legacy auth, e.g., AZURE\\ ). - `password_secure` - (Optional) Password as SecureString (legacy auth, inline). - `sas_uri` - (Optional) Plain SAS URI without token. Use with key_vault_sas_token. - `sas_uri_secure` - (Optional) SAS URI as SecureString (inline). - `encrypted_credential` - (Optional) Encrypted credential for authentication. - `description` - (Optional) Description for the Linked Service. - `integration_runtime_name` - (Optional) Integration runtime reference name. - `annotations` - (Optional) List of tags for describing the Linked Service. - `parameters` - (Optional) Map of parameters to associate with the Linked Service. - `connection_string_key_vault` - (Optional) Key Vault reference for the entire connection string (including account key) stored as a single secret. network_config.description: - `network_config` - (Optional). Object with cofigration for the network config. As defined below - `context` - (Optional) Context to be used for Storage Account being deployed resources. - `instance` - (Optional) instance to be used for Storage Account being deployed resources. - `use_existing_subnet` - (Optional) Boolean to use existing subnet for the Virtial Machine deployments. - `winvm_subnet_address_prefix` - (Optional) Address prefix for the subnet where windows Virtual Machines will be deployed. Must be passed as `null` if `use_existing_subnet` is `true`. - `subnet_id` - (Optional) The ID of the Subnet where the VM Network Interface should be located in. - `default_outbound_access` - (Optional) Boolean to enable default outbound access for the subnet where Virtual Machines will be deployed. Default is false. - `security_rules` - (Optional). Map of objects mentioned below security rules of the NSG to be deployed and attached with Virtual Machiine Subnet. As defined below - `name` - (Required) The name of the security rule. - `description` - (Optional) A description for this rule. Restricted to 140 characters. - `priority` - (Required) Specifies the priority of the rule. The value can be between 100 and 4096. The priority number must be unique for each rule in the collection. The lower the priority number, the higher the priority of the rule. - `direction` - (Required) The direction specifies if rule will be evaluated on incoming or outgoing traffic. Possible values are Inbound and Outbound. - `access` - (Required) Specifies whether network traffic is allowed or denied. Possible values are Allow and Deny. - `protocol` - (Required) Network protocol this rule applies to. Possible values include Tcp, Udp, Icmp, Esp, Ah or * (which matches all). - `source_port_range` - (Optional) Source Port or Range. Integer or range between 0 and 65535 or * to match any. This is required if source_port_ranges is not specified. - `destination_port_range` - (Optional) Destination Port or Range. Integer or range between 0 and 65535 or * to match any. This is required if destination_port_ranges is not specified. - `source_address_prefix` - (Optional) CIDR or source IP range or * to match any IP. Tags such as VirtualNetwork, AzureLoadBalancer and Internet can also be used. This is required if source_address_prefixes is not specified. - `destination_address_prefix` - (Optional) CIDR or destination IP range or * to match any IP. Tags such as VirtualNetwork, AzureLoadBalancer and Internet can also be used. This is required if destination_address_prefixes is not specified. - `source_application_security_group_ids` - (Optional) A List of source Application Security Group IDs. - `destination_application_security_group_ids` - (Optional) A List of destination Application Security Group IDs. - `route_table` - (Optional). Object with route table configuration for Virtual Machine Subnet. As defined below - `route_table_id` - (Optional) Route table ID to be used for PSQL Subnet. Required if route is not provided. - `route` - (Optional) A Map of objects mentioned below for route configuration of the route table. - `name` - (Required) The name of the route." - `address_prefix` - (Required) The destination CIDR to which the route applies." - `next_hop_type` - (Required) The type of Azure hop the packet should be sent to. Possible values are VirtualNetworkGateway, VnetLocal, Internet, VirtualAppliance and None." - `next_hop_in_ip_address` - (Optional) The IP address packets should be forwarded to. Next hop values are only allowed in routes where the next hop type is VirtualAppliance." - `bgp_route_propagation_enabled` - (Optional) Boolean flag which controls propagation of routes learned by BGP on that route table. True means disable. - `private_endpoint_adf` - (Required) An object for data factory private endpoint. - `context` - (Optional) Context to be used for private endpoint being deployed. - `instance` - (Optional) Instance to be used for private endpoint being deployed. - `is_manual_connection` - (Optional) Boolean to indicate if the connection is manual. Default is false. - `static_ip_required` - (Optional) Boolean to indicate if static IP is required. Default is false. - `private_connection_resource_alias` - (Optional) Resource alias of the private connection. Required if is_manual_connection is true. - `request_message` - (Optional) A message passed to the owner of the remote resource when the private endpoint attempts to establish the connection to the remote resource. The provider allows a maximum request message length of `140` characters, however the request message maximum length is dependent on the service the private endpoint is connected to. Only valid if `is_manual_connection` is set to true. - `ip_configuration` - (Optional) Object with IP configuration for KeyVault. As defined below - `private_ip_address` - (Required). Private IP address of the IP configuration. - `subresource_name` - (Optional). Subresource name of the IP configuration. Default is vault. - `member_name` - (Optional). Member name of the IP configuration. Default is default. - `private_endpoint_adf_portal` - (Required) An object for data factory private endpoint. - `context` - (Optional) Context to be used for private endpoint being deployed. - `instance` - (Optional) Instance to be used for private endpoint being deployed. - `is_manual_connection` - (Optional) Boolean to indicate if the connection is manual. The provider allows a maximum request message length of `140` characters, however the request message maximum length is dependent on the service the private endpoint is connected to. Only valid if `is_manual_connection` is set to true. - `ip_configuration` - (Optional) Object with IP configuration for KeyVault. As defined below - `private_ip_address` - (Required). ssis_integration_runtime_config.description: (Optional) Configuration wrapper for SSIS Integration Runtime deployment. - `deploy_ssis_ir` - (Optional) Boolean flag to enable/disable SSIS-IR deployment (default: false). Subnet Creation Parameters: - `create_ssis_subnet` - (Optional) Boolean flag to create a dedicated subnet for SSIS-IR (default: false). - `ssis_subnet_context` - (Optional) Context for SSIS subnet naming (default: "ssis"). - `ssis_subnet_instance` - (Optional) Instance number for SSIS subnet naming (default: "001"). - `ssis_subnet_address_prefix` - (Optional) Address prefix for SSIS subnet (required when create_ssis_subnet is true). - `ssis_bgp_route_propagation_enabled` - (Optional) Enable BGP route propagation on SSIS subnet route table (default: true). - `ssis_integration_runtime` - (Optional) A map of SSIS Integration Runtime configurations, where the key is the runtime name and the value is the configuration object: - `location` - (Required) Specifies the supported Azure location where the resource exists. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. - `node_size` - (Required) The size of the nodes on which the Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime runs. Valid values: Standard_D2_v3, Standard_D4_v3, Standard_D8_v3, Standard_D16_v3, Standard_D32_v3, Standard_D64_v3, Standard_E2_v3, Standard_E4_v3, Standard_E8_v3, Standard_E16_v3, Standard_E32_v3, Standard_E64_v3, Standard_D1_v2, Standard_D2_v2, Standard_D3_v2, Standard_D4_v2, Standard_A4_v2, Standard_A8_v2 - `number_of_nodes` - (Optional) Number of nodes for the Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime. Max is 10. Defaults to 1. - `credential_name` - (Optional) The name of a Data Factory Credential that the SSIS integration will use to access data sources. If omitted, the integration runtime will use the Data Factory assigned identity. - `max_parallel_executions_per_node` - (Optional) Defines the maximum parallel executions per node. Defaults to 1. Max is 1. - `edition` - (Optional) The Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime edition. Valid values: Standard, Enterprise. Defaults to Standard. - `license_type` - (Optional) The type of the license that is used. Valid values: LicenseIncluded, BasePrice. Defaults to LicenseIncluded. SSIS Catalog Configuration: - `catalog_info` - (Optional) A catalog_info block for SSIS catalog configuration: - `server_endpoint` - (Required) The endpoint of an Azure SQL Server that will be used to host the SSIS catalog. - `administrator_login` - (Optional) Administrator login name for the SQL Server. - `administrator_password` - (Optional) Administrator login password for the SQL Server. - `pricing_tier` - (Optional) Pricing tier for the database that will be created for the SSIS catalog. Valid values: Basic, S0, S1, S2, S3, S4, S6, S7, S9, S12, P1, P2, P4, P6, P11, P15, GP_S_Gen5_*, GP_Gen5_*, BC_Gen5_*, HS_Gen5_*. Mutually exclusive with elastic_pool_name. - `elastic_pool_name` - (Optional) The name of SQL elastic pool where the database will be created for the SSIS catalog. Mutually exclusive with pricing_tier. - `dual_standby_pair_name` - (Optional) The dual standby Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime pair with SSISDB failover. Performance Tuning: - `copy_compute_scale` - (Optional) A copy_compute_scale block for Data Factory Integration Runtime: - `data_integration_unit` - (Optional) Specifies the data integration unit number setting reserved for copy activity execution. Supported values are multiples of 4 in range 4-256. - `time_to_live` - (Optional) Specifies the time to live (in minutes) setting of integration runtime which will execute copy activity. Possible values are at least 5. - `pipeline_external_compute_scale` - (Optional) A pipeline_external_compute_scale block for Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime: - `number_of_external_nodes` - (Optional) Specifies the number of the external nodes, which should be greater than 0 and less than 11. - `number_of_pipeline_nodes` - (Optional) Specifies the number of the pipeline nodes, which should be greater than 0 and less than 11. - `time_to_live` - (Optional) Specifies the time to live (in minutes) setting of integration runtime which will execute copy activity. Possible values are at least 5. Custom Setup: - `custom_setup_script` - (Optional) A custom_setup_script block for Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime: - `blob_container_uri` - (Required) The blob endpoint for the container which contains a custom setup script that will be run on every node on startup. - `sas_token` - (Required) A container SAS token that gives access to the files. - `express_custom_setup` - (Optional) An express_custom_setup block for Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime: - `command_key` - (Optional) A list of command_key blocks (see below for structure). - `component` - (Optional) A list of component blocks (see below for structure). - `environment` - (Optional) The Environment Variables for the Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime. - `powershell_version` - (Optional) The version of Azure Powershell installed for the Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime. VNet Integration (Required): - `express_vnet_integration` - (Required) An express_vnet_integration block for Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime: - `subnet_id` - (Required) ID of the subnet to which the nodes of the Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime will be added. Package Store: - `package_store` - (Optional) A list of package_store blocks for Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime: - `name` - (Required) Name of the package store. - `linked_service_name` - (Required) Name of the Linked Service to associate with the packages. Proxy Configuration: - `proxy` - (Optional) A proxy block for Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime: - `self_hosted_integration_runtime_name` - (Required) Name of Self Hosted Integration Runtime as a proxy. - `staging_storage_linked_service_name` - (Required) Name of Azure Blob Storage linked service to reference the staging data store to be used when moving data between self-hosted and Azure-SSIS integration runtimes. - `path` - (Optional) The path in the data store to be used when moving data between Self-Hosted and Azure-SSIS Integration Runtimes. Command Key Configuration (Legacy): - `command_key` - (Optional) A list of command_key blocks for Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime: - `target_name` - (Required) The target computer or domain name. - `user_name` - (Required) The username for the target device. - `password` - (Optional) The password for the target device. - `key_vault_password` - (Optional) A key_vault_secret_reference block: - `linked_service_name` - (Required) Specifies the name of an existing Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service. - `secret_name` - (Required) Specifies the secret name in Azure Key Vault. - `secret_version` - (Optional) Specifies the secret version in Azure Key Vault. - `parameters` - (Optional) A map of parameters to associate with the Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service. Component Configuration (Legacy): - `component` - (Optional) A list of component blocks for Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime: - `name` - (Required) The Component Name installed for the Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime. - `license` - (Optional) The license used for the Component. - `key_vault_license` - (Optional) A key_vault_secret_reference block: - `linked_service_name` - (Required) Specifies the name of an existing Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service. - `secret_name` - (Required) Specifies the secret name in Azure Key Vault. - `secret_version` - (Optional) Specifies the secret version in Azure Key Vault. - `parameters` - (Optional) A map of parameters to associate with the Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service.

storage_account_config.description: (Optional) Configuration for deploying a Storage Account for File Storage Linked Services. When set, the pattern will deploy a storage account that can be used by file share linked services. Optionally creates dedicated subnet, NSG, route table, and User-Assigned Managed Identity for CMK. - `deploy_storage_account` - (Required) Boolean flag to enable/disable storage account deployment (default: false). - `context` - (Optional) Application context for the storage account (max 10 chars). Defaults to pattern context. - `instance` - (Optional) Instance number for the storage account (max 3 int). Defaults to pattern instance. - `blob_pe_instance` - (Optional) Instance number for the blob private endpoint (max 3 int). Defaults to pattern instance. - `file_pe_instance` - (Optional) Instance number for the file share private endpoint (max 3 int). Defaults to pattern instance. - `account_tier` - (Optional) Storage account tier: Standard or Premium (default: "Standard"). - `account_kind` - (Optional) Storage account kind: StorageV2, BlobStorage, FileStorage (default: "StorageV2"). - `account_replication_type` - (Optional) Replication type: LRS, GRS, RAGRS, ZRS, GZRS, RAGZRS (default: "LRS"). - `https_traffic_only_enabled` - (Optional) To implement securtiy control, this property needs to be true to use techniques to establish an encrypted data channels over untrusted networks. However this needs to be false for file share because Azure Files doesn't currently support encryption-in-transit with the NFS protocol and relies instead on network-level security. - `network_access_enabled` - (Optional) Allow public network access (default: false for security). - `enable_file_share_AADDS_authentication` - (Optional) Enable Azure AD DS authentication for file shares (default: false). Subnet Configuration (Optional - creates dedicated subnet for storage account): - `create_subnet` - (Optional) Boolean to create dedicated subnet for storage account (default: false). - `subnet_address_prefix` - (Optional) CIDR for storage subnet (required if create_subnet=true). - `subnet_context` - (Optional) Context for subnet naming (default: "stg"). - `subnet_instance` - (Optional) Instance for subnet naming (default: "001"). - `existing_subnet_id` - (Optional) Use existing subnet ID instead of creating new one. Network Rules (Optional): - `network_rules` - (Optional) Network ACL rules for storage account. - `bypass` - (Optional) Bypass for AzureServices, Logging, Metrics (default: ["AzureServices"]). - `virtual_network_subnet_ids` - (Optional) List of additional subnet IDs allowed to access storage (created subnet auto-included). - `ip_rules` - (Optional) List of public IP addresses allowed. Customer Managed Key Configuration (Optional): - `enable_cmk` - (Optional) Enable Customer Managed Key encryption (default: false). - `cmk_expiration_date` - (Optional) CMK expiration date in ISO 8601 format (required if enable_cmk=true). - `cmk_umi_context` - (Optional) Context for CMK User-Assigned Managed Identity (default: "stcmk"). - `cmk_umi_instance` - (Optional) Instance for CMK UMI (default: "001"). Identity Configuration (Optional): - `identity` - (Optional) Managed Identity configuration for storage account. - `type` - (Required) Identity type: SystemAssigned, UserAssigned, or SystemAssigned,UserAssigned. - `identity_ids` - (Optional) List of additional User-Assigned Managed Identity IDs (CMK UMI auto-included if enable_cmk=true).

win_vm_variables.description: - `win_vm_variables` - (Required) Object with cofigration for the Oracle Virtual Machine. As defined below - `context` - (Optional) Context to be used for Oracle Virtual Machine being deployed resources. - `instance` - (Optional) Instance to be used for Oracle Virtual Machine being deployed resources. - `secure_boot_enabled` - (Optional) Specifies whether secure boot should be enabled on the virtual machine. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. - `enable_systemassigned_identity` - (Optional). Whether to deploy the VM with SystemAssigned identity. By default this is false and the VM is deployed with userassigned identity only. - `enable_systemassigned_identity_des` - (Optional). Whether to deploy the DES with SystemAssigned identity. By default this is false and the DES is deployed with userassigned identity only. - `size` - (Required) The SKU which should be used for this Virtual Machine. - `admin_username` - (Required) The username of the local administrator used for the Virtual Machine. - `computer_name` - (Optional) Specifies the Hostname which should be used for this Virtual Machine. - `license_type` - (Optional) Specifies the BYOL Type for this Virtual Machine. Possible values are RHEL_BYOS and SLES_BYOS. - `availability_set_id` - (Optional) Specifies the ID of the Availability Set in which the Virtual Machine should exist. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. - `capacity_reservation_group_id` - (Optional) The ID of the Capacity Reservation Group which the Virtual Machine should be assigned to. - `proximity_placement_group_id` - (Optional) The ID of the Proximity Placement Group which the Virtual Machine should be assigned to. - `zone` - (Optional) Specifies the Availability Zones in which this Linux Virtual Machine should be located. Changing this forces a new Linux Virtual Machine to be created. - `source_image_id` - (Optional) The ID of the Image which this Virtual Machine should be created from. - `os_disk` - (Required) A os_disk for the VM. The block supports the following - `storage_account_type` - (Optional) The Type of Storage Account which should back this the Internal OS Disk. Possible values are Standard_LRS, StandardSSD_LRS, Premium_LRS, StandardSSD_ZRS and Premium_ZRS. - `disk_size_gb` - (Optional) The Size of the Internal OS Disk in GB, if you wish to vary from the size used in the image this Virtual Machine is sourced from. - `caching` - (Optional) The Type of Caching which should be used for the Internal OS Disk. Possible values are None, ReadOnly and ReadWrite. - `network_access_policy` - (Optional) Policy for accessing the disk via network. Possible values are AllowAll, AllowPrivate and DenyAll. - `public_network_access` - (Optional) Whether the disk is accessible via public network. Possible values are Enabled and Disabled. - `network_interface` - (Required) A Network Interface that should be created and attached to this Virtual Machine. - `ip_configurations` - A list of object for virtual machine IP configuration - `private_ip_address` - (Optional) The Static IP Address which should be used. When `private_ip_address_allocation` is set to `Static` this field can be configured. - `private_ip_address_version` - (Optional) The IP Version to use. Possible values are `IPv4` or `IPv6`. Defaults to `IPv4`. - `private_ip_address_allocation` - (Required) The allocation method used for the Private IP Address. Possible values are `Dynamic` and `Static`. Defaults to `Dynamic`. - `subnet_id` - (Optional) The ID of the Subnet where the VM Network Interface should be located in. - `primary` - (Optional) Is this the Primary IP Configuration? Must be `true` for the first `ip_configuration`. Defaults to `false`. - `gateway_load_balancer_frontend_ip_configuration_id` - (Optional) The Frontend IP Configuration ID of a Gateway SKU Load Balancer. - `dns_servers` - (Optional) A list of IP Addresses defining the DNS Servers which should be used for this Network Interface. Configuring DNS Servers on the Network Interface will override the DNS Servers defined on the Virtual Network. - `edge_zone` - (Optional) Specifies the Edge Zone within the Azure Region where this Network Interface should exist. Changing this forces a new Network Interface to be created. - `enable_accelerated_networking` - (Optional) Should Accelerated Networking be enabled? Defaults to `false`. Only certain Virtual Machine sizes are supported for Accelerated Networking - [more information can be found in this document](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-network/create-vm-accelerated-networking-cli). To use Accelerated Networking in an Availability Set, the Availability Set must be deployed onto an Accelerated Networking enabled cluster. - `ip_forwarding_enabled` - (Optional) Should IP Forwarding be enabled? Defaults to `false`. - `internal_dns_name_label` - (Optional) The (relative) DNS Name used for internal communications between Virtual Machines in the same Virtual Network. - `boot_diagnostics_storage_account_uri` - (Optional) The Primary/Secondary Endpoint for the Azure Storage Account which should be used to store Boot Diagnostics. - `vtpm_enabled` - (Optional) Specifies whether vTPM should be enabled on the virtual machine. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. - `virtual_machine_scale_set_id` - (Optional) Specifies the Orchestrated Virtual Machine Scale Set that this Virtual Machine should be created within. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. - `virtual_machine_extensions` - (Optional) A Virtual Machine Extension block as defined below - `name` - (Required) The name of the virtual machine extension peering." - `publisher` - (Required) The publisher of the extension, available publishers can be found by using the Azure CLI.`az vm extension image list --location westus -o table`." - `type` - (Required) The type of extension, available types for a publisher can be found using the Azure CLI." - `type_handler_version` - (Required) Specifies the version of the extension to use, available versions can be found using the Azure CLI." - `auto_upgrade_minor_version` - (Optional) Specifies if the platform deploys the latest minor version update to the type_handler_version specified." - `automatic_upgrade_enabled` - (Optional) Should the Extension be automatically updated whenever the Publisher releases a new version of this VM Extension?" - `settings` - (Optional) The settings passed to the extension, these are specified as a JSON object in a string." - `failure_suppression_enabled` - (Optional) Should failures from the extension be suppressed? Possible values are true or false. Defaults to false." - `protected_settings` - (Optional) The protected_settings passed to the extension, like settings, these are specified as a JSON object in a string." - `provision_after_extensions` - (Optional) Specifies the collection of extension names after which this extension needs to be provisioned." - `protected_settings_from_key_vault` - (optional) An object for protected settings from key vault for virtual machine extension - `secret_url` - (Optional) Specifies the collection of extension names after which this extension needs to be provisioned." - `source_vault_id` - (Required) The ID of the source Key Vault." - `enable_entra_auth` - (Optional) The boolean to enable entra authentication for Windows Virtual Machine. - `additional_disk` - (Optional) Object for adding additional data disk for windows virtual machine. - `instance` - (Optional) Instance to be used for Oracle Virtual Machine being deployed resources. - `context` - (Optional) Context to be used for Oracle Virtual Machine being deployed resources. - `attach_disk_to_vm` - (Optional) Boolean to attach disk to VM. - `enable_disk_backup` - (Optional) Boolean to enable backup for additional disk. - `storage_account_type` - (Optional) The type of storage to use for the managed disk. Possible values are Standard_LRS, StandardSSD_ZRS, Premium_LRS, PremiumV2_LRS, Premium_ZRS, StandardSSD_LRS or UltraSSD_LRS. - `source_uri` - (Optional) URI to a valid VHD file to be used for the disk creation. - `source_resource_id` - (Optional) The ID of an existing Managed Disk or Snapshot to copy from. - `image_reference_id` - (Optional) ID of an existing platform/marketplace disk image to copy from - `availability_zone` - (optional) The Availability Zone in which this Managed Disk should be located. Make sure the disk sku you want to use can be created in availability zone. - `os_type` - (Optional) Specify a value when the source is an Import, Copy or Image. - `disk_encryption_set_id` - (Required) The resource ID of a Disk Encryption Set which should be used to encrypt this Managed Disk. - `disk_size_gb` - (Optional) Specifies the size of the managed disk to create in gigabytes. If create_option is Copy or FromImage, then the value must be equal to or greater than the source's size. The size can only be increased. Defaults to `128` - `caching` - (Optional) Specifies the caching requirements for this Data Disk. - `lun` - (Optional) The Logical Unit Number of the Data Disk, which needs to be unique within the Virtual Machine. - `ultra_ssd_disk_iops_read_write` - (Optional) The number of IOPS allowed for this disk; only settable for UltraSSD disks and PremiumV2 disks. One operation can transfer between 4k and 256k bytes. - `ultra_ssd_disk_mbps_read_write` - (Optional) The bandwidth allowed for this disk; only settable for UltraSSD disks and PremiumV2 disks. MBps means millions of bytes per second.
